title: The Lost Children
text: Children's voices drift through the trees, high and sweet, playing a counting game. One, two, three, then a giggle. They are always just out of sight among the trunks, calling for you to play too. Somebody always has to be it.

options.label: Play their counting game; somebody has to be it.

outcomes.text: They are only lost children after all. Giggling, they show you the way out.
They are not children, and you are it.

options.label: The cleverest listens to how they count, and to what they leave out.

outcomes.text: They skip the same number every time. Something hides in that number, waiting to be found.

options.label: Stop your ears and walk on; whatever plays out there is no child.

outcomes.text: The counting follows until dark. By then, it is counting you.
